server_info.command_description: Display server system information including CPU, memory usage and Discord API latency
server_info.error_psutil: The `psutil` library is not installed. Please install it to use this command.
mcavatar.param.player: Minecraft username to use (optional if image is provided)
mcavatar.param.image: Skin image attachment (optional if player is provided)
mcavatar.param.outline_color: Outline color: auto / auto_darker / auto_lighter or hex (#000000)
mcavatar.param.bg_color: Background color: auto / auto_lighter / auto_darker or hex (#ffffff)
mcavatar.param.average_color: Average color for auto outline/bg: hex (#ff0000) or auto
mcavatar.error.need_player_or_image: You must provide either a player name or an image attachment.
mcavatar.error.invalid_average_color: Invalid average_color format. Use hex like #ff0000 or #f00.
mcavatar.error.script_not_found: Internal error: Node.js script not found. Please contact admin.
